title: 수도방위사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28211:20170726:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 28211, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That where provisions of Presidential Decrees amended under Article 8 of these Addenda amend Presidential Decrees promulgated but not yet in force before this Decree enters into force, each such amended provision shall enter into force on the enforcement date of the corresponding Presidential Decree.

Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (85) Omitted.

(86) The Decree on the Capital Defense Command is partially amended as follows:

In Article 5 (2), "Chief of the Presidential Security Office" shall be replaced with "Chief of the Presidential Security Service".

In the latter part of Article 7, "Minister of the Interior" shall be replaced with "Minister of the Interior and Safety".

(87) through (388) Omitted.
